name: Visual7W: Grounded Question Answering in Images
description: Visual7W is a grounded question answering dataset built on 47,300 images from COCO / Visual Genome. It introduces rich semantic question answering covering seven 'W' question categories (What, Where, When, Who, Why, How, and Which), with 327,939 total QA pairs and 1,311,756 multiple-choice choices grounded in object bounding boxes.
